text: Hey guys, this is part 3 of the video where I translate what women say. Situation 1. When you ask the girl out, she tells you, I am not sure about my schedule, I will text you later. Translation. A lot of the times this is a polite rejection and she will not text you later. What to do? You can text her right away that it's okay and that you can check back on her later. But if she still flakes, when you text, you need to move on. Situation 2. Before you even met a girl, she is telling you that she is looking for a mature guy or a man who knows how to treat a woman. Translation. She is looking for a financially stable man who will invite her to restaurants and upgrade her lifestyle. What to do? I would suggest that you avoid women like this. Ideally, you should invest your time meeting women who want to meet you for who you are, not for what you can give them. Situation 3. A girl agrees to the second date but says, let's agree that this time you won't be so persistent. Translation. She actually liked what you were doing on the first date. What to do? Keep doing what you were doing. Flirt and be persistent. To a reasonable extent, of course. You need to understand. If she didn't like you or the things that you did when you first met, she wouldn't want to meet you a second time.
